items.prompt: Teaching style lint prefers clock nets named…
items.explain: Consistent clk naming helps readers spot timing references instantly.

items.prompt: Active-low reset naming in this course often uses…
items.explain: The _n suffix signals active-low reset without reading the sensitivity list.

items.prompt: For edge-triggered flip-flops, SystemVerilog style prefers…
items.explain: always_ff documents sequential intent and is the preferred SV keyword.

items.prompt: Style findings in the teaching linter are usually info/warning hints that do not block simulation by themselves.
items.explain: Style lint trains naming and keyword habits; synthesizability lint catches harder RTL mistakes.
